# Capability reference

Every operation Mnemos exposes, and how each transport provides it. A cell is either the operations that implement the capability or the reason the transport does not. **GAP** marks an omission that is not a decision: an operation that should exist on that transport and does not yet.

| Transport | Surface |
|---|---|
| go | the embedded library, `mnemos.Memory` |
| rest | `mnemos serve` |
| grpc | `mnemos.v1.MnemosService` |
| mcp | `mnemos mcp` (stdio and `--http`) |
| mcp-lite | the root `mcp` package, a core subset |
| http-lite | the root `http` package, a core subset |
| client | `go.klarlabs.de/mnemos/client` |

77 capabilities, 0 acknowledged gaps.

## Capabilities

### ingest.text

Extract beliefs from free text (ingest → extract → relate → persist) (write).

| Transport | Binding |
|---|---|
| go | `Remember` |
| rest | `POST /v1/process` |
| grpc | `ProcessText` |
| mcp | `process_text` |
| mcp-lite | `remember` |
| http-lite | `POST /v1/remember` |
| client | `Process` |

> REST, gRPC and MCP run the same pipeline (REST and gRPC through runProcessRequest, which calls process_text's mcpRunProcessText); Go and the lite adapters go through Memory.Remember.

### episode.retract

Withdraw an episode as evidence: retract beliefs it alone supported, rescore the rest, report the impact (ADR 0037) (write).

| Transport | Binding |
|---|---|
| go | `RetractEvent` |
| rest | `POST /v1/episodes/{id}/retract` |
| grpc | `RetractEpisode` |
| mcp | `retract_episode` |
| mcp-lite | _the lite adapters expose only the core Store port: remember, remember_claim/event, recall, get, scan, timeline_ |
| http-lite | _the lite adapters expose only the core Store port: remember, remember_claim/event, recall, get, scan, timeline_ |
| client | `RetractEvent` |

> Every binding and `mnemos retract-event` go through internal/retraction.Run (id, existence and run-scope checks) and govwrite's one retraction: Writer.RetractEvent on the daemon surfaces, ApplyRetraction inside the library's governed kernel. REST, MCP and the CLI return the same retraction.Report. watch_file calls Writer.RetractEvent for text a revised or deleted file no longer contains.

### episode.unretract

Clear an episode's retraction: restore the beliefs it deprecated that nothing changed since, relink the ones it rescored (ADR 0037 §8) (write).

| Transport | Binding |
|---|---|
| go | `UnretractEvent` |
| rest | `POST /v1/episodes/{id}/unretract` |
| grpc | `UnretractEpisode` |
| mcp | `unretract_episode` |
| mcp-lite | _the lite adapters expose only the core Store port: remember, remember_claim/event, recall, get, scan, timeline_ |
| http-lite | _the lite adapters expose only the core Store port: remember, remember_claim/event, recall, get, scan, timeline_ |
| client | `UnretractEvent` |

> Every binding and `mnemos unretract-event` go through internal/retraction.Unretract (id, existence, run-scope and was-it-ever-retracted checks) and govwrite's one un-retraction: Writer.UnretractEvent on the daemon surfaces, ApplyUnretraction inside the library's governed kernel. REST, MCP and the CLI return the same retraction.UnretractionReport. A never-retracted episode is REST 409 / gRPC FailedPrecondition.

### belief.remember_fact

Store one fact as a belief, creating its evidence episode (write).

| Transport | Binding |
|---|---|
| go | `RememberClaimWithEvidence`, `RememberClaimWithEvidenceDetailed` |
| rest | `POST /v1/facts` |
| grpc | `RememberFact` |
| mcp | `remember` |
| mcp-lite | _the lite adapters expose only the core Store port: remember, remember_claim/event, recall, get, scan, timeline_ |
| http-lite | _the lite adapters expose only the core Store port: remember, remember_claim/event, recall, get, scan, timeline_ |
| client | `RememberClaimWithEvidence`, `RememberClaimWithEvidenceDetailed` |

> REST, gRPC and the client go through Memory.RememberClaimWithEvidence (one observation episode per evidence string, run-scoped tokens refused). MCP remember is a separate implementation that records the fact text itself as its one run-scoped episode. Every binding folds a restatement of a held belief onto it (pipeline.CollapseKnownClaims), returning the held belief id and known=true.

### belief.govern

Agent governance edits: deprecate, forget, update text, resolve or escalate a dissonance, promote (write).

| Transport | Binding |
|---|---|
| go | `DeprecateClaim`, `UpdateClaim`, `ResolveContradiction`, `EscalateClaim`, `VerifyClaim` |
| rest | `POST /v1/beliefs/{id}/deprecate`, `POST /v1/beliefs/{id}/update`, `POST /v1/beliefs/{id}/resolve`, `POST /v1/beliefs/{id}/escalate`, `POST /v1/beliefs/{id}/verify` |
| grpc | `DeprecateBelief`, `UpdateBelief`, `ResolveDissonance`, `EscalateBelief`, `VerifyBelief` |
| mcp | `memory_deprecate`, `forget`, `update`, `memory_resolve_dissonance`, `memory_escalate`, `memory_promote` |
| mcp-lite | _the lite adapters expose only the core Store port: remember, remember_claim/event, recall, get, scan, timeline_ |
| http-lite | _the lite adapters expose only the core Store port: remember, remember_claim/event, recall, get, scan, timeline_ |
| client | `DeprecateClaim`, `UpdateClaim`, `ResolveContradiction`, `EscalateClaim`, `VerifyClaim` |

> Every binding runs internal/beliefops. MCP forget and memory_deprecate are one operation (Deprecate) recording different default reasons, so the other transports expose it once; memory_promote is Verify (last_verified, verify_count, last_confirmed) and takes promote:global on every transport. Escalate returns a verdict and writes nothing.
